BP5-SVC-013 implementation complete. All 7 kill-switch and evolution HTTP routes added to main.py, matching client methods added to runtime_manager_client.py, and smoke tests covering both service and HTTP layers pass 115/115. Please review for policy alignment with KILL_SWITCH_AND_SAFE_MODE_EXECUTION_POLICY.md and EVOLUTION_REVIEW_AND_THRESHOLDS.md.

Review found blocking policy mismatches; see .coordination/reviews/BP5-SVC-013-review.md. Required: make kill-switch execute runtime-manager action/state writes, route freeze follow-through through DeploymentPlan/Rollback boundaries, and have retrain/redeploy consume authoritative downstream work items instead of synthetic receipts.

All three review blockers resolved — ready for re-review. Summary of fixes: (1) execute_kill_switch: added _execute_kill_switch_binding_action() helper that executes PAUSE/RISK_OFF→pending_pause→paused and LIQUIDATE/REPLACE/TERMINATE→retire against RuntimeBinding after dispatch; (2) evolution_freeze: added required deployment_plan_id param, renamed freeze_action→plan_runtime_action, removed liquidate_then_freeze (raises error directing caller to kill-switch/rollback path); (3) evolution_retrain: requires research_job_id from research plane and uses it as routing_ref; evolution_redeploy: accepts deployment_plan sub-dict only, validates required plan fields, no raw artifact/binding passthrough. smoke_test.py updated throughout. 115/115 pass.
Review requested changes: kill-switch REPLACE fast path still only retires the current binding and never deploys the fallback replacement runtime. See .coordination/reviews/BP5-SVC-013-review.md.

REPLACE fast path now complete: hot-swap semantics implemented in _execute_kill_switch_binding_action() — fallback binding created first (_allow_cutover_bypass=True), old binding retired after. 16 new smoke tests cover service-layer and HTTP REPLACE paths; all 131 checks pass. Ready for re-review.
Review failed: evolution_freeze must tolerate bindings already paused by kill-switch/rollback and add cross-path smoke coverage for kill-switch pause -> freeze follow-through.

Review-requested fixes applied: (1) evolution_freeze now tolerates bindings already paused or pending_pause by kill-switch/rollback — idempotent drain path replaces the unconditional transition_status call that raised RuntimeBindingError on paused→paused. (2) Added two cross-path smoke scenarios: kill-switch PAUSE → evolution_freeze on already-paused binding (7 new checks), and pending_pause partial-drain → evolution_freeze completion (2 new checks). All 138 smoke checks pass. Ready for re-review.
Review approved: kill-switch/evolution freeze cross-path is now idempotent; owner should finalize to done.
